claim: Rona vs Home Depot vs Lowes : r/ottawa - Reddit
summary: Lowes generally have the best selection of products, Home Depot have the most helpful staff. I want to shop at Rona because I want to support Canadian businesses but I find them almost uniformly miserable and unhelpful. The best deals of all, along with a very good selection of products, are at Reno Depot in Gatineau by the casino.
